description: This Python module provides utilities for calculating costs associated with explainable AI (XAI) models and web search requests. It includes functions to compute token-based costs with XAI-specific reasoning token handling and to estimate the cost of web search sources used during interactions.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_token(model: str, usage: Usage)
methods.description: Calculates the cost per token for a given XAI model, including reasoning tokens if present, leveraging a generic cost calculator.

methods.name: float cost_per_web_search_request(usage: "Usage", model_info: "ModelInfo")
methods.description: Calculates the total cost of web search requests based on the number of sources used, with specific pricing for X.AI models.
